verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an official MCP server ('GitBook MCP server is here. Connect your AI agent') that lets MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor create/configure sites, open change requests, draft content, edit pages, and restructure docs — a clear agent-connectivity capability, not just consuming other MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability and no third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
